crossRefs.note: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One…

translations.web: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
translations.bsb: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”
translations.kjv: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
translations.asv: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a worm!
